standard: course-sentence-translation 技能 R1–R4；键取自对齐原串

entries.en: As you probably know, the town council have got £1 million to spend on improving the town’s facilities for young people and we’re looking for great ideas on how to spend the money well.
entries.zh: 你可能已经知道，镇议会有 100 万英镑要花在改善镇上年轻人的设施上，我们正在寻找把钱花好的好点子。

entries.en: Post your ideas in the forum below and let us know how we can make life better for you.
entries.zh: 请在下面的论坛里发布你的想法，告诉我们怎样能让你们的生活更好。

entries.en: There’s nothing for teenagers to do in this town, especially at night.
entries.zh: 这个镇上的青少年晚上没事可做。

entries.en: Can we use the money to build a youth club?
entries.zh: 我们能不能用这笔钱建一个青少年俱乐部？

entries.en: Somewhere with a pool table and a table tennis table, perhaps.
entries.zh: 也许里面可以放一张台球桌和一张乒乓球桌。

entries.en: We need somewhere to play happily and hang out safely in the evenings.
entries.zh: 我们需要一个晚上可以开心玩耍、安全聚在一起的地方。

entries.en: As I’m only 14, I can’t drive, so I go everywhere on my bike.
entries.zh: 我只有 14 岁，不能开车，所以我去哪儿都骑自行车。

entries.en: But the roads are dangerous and many motorists drive too fast.
entries.zh: 但马路很危险，很多开车的人开得太快。

entries.en: How about spending the money on building more cycle lanes?
entries.zh: 把这些钱用来多建几条自行车道怎么样？

entries.en: We could also put in more speed cameras and zebra crossings, too.
entries.zh: 我们还可以多装一些测速摄像头和斑马线。

entries.en: This will make life safer for all our citizens, not just the young people.
entries.zh: 这会让我们所有市民的生活都更安全，不只是年轻人。

entries.en: I think the best use for the money is to build a playground in the town park.
entries.zh: 我觉得这笔钱最好的用法是在镇公园里建一个游乐场。

entries.en: It should have lots of rides for the young kids but also stuff for teenagers, too.
entries.zh: 它应该有很多小孩子玩的游乐设施，但也要有给青少年的东西。

entries.en: I’d like to see a graffiti wall and a skateboard park for a start and maybe if there is enough money, we can have a climbing wall, too.
entries.zh: 首先我想看到一个涂鸦墙和一个滑板公园，也许钱够的话还可以有一个攀岩墙。

entries.en: Our high street is full of empty shops because everyone just shops at the new shopping centre outside of town or online.
entries.zh: 我们的主街上到处都是空店铺，因为大家都去镇外的新购物中心或者网上购物。

entries.en: Why don’t we use the money to turn some of these empty shops into an arts centre?
entries.zh: 我们为什么不把这些空店铺改成艺术中心呢？

entries.en: It can have studios where we can draw and paint or learn how to make films.
entries.zh: 里面可以有工作室，我们可以在那里画画、涂色或者学习拍电影。

entries.en: We could also have a music studio where local bands can record music cheaply.
entries.zh: 我们还可以有一个音乐工作室，让本地乐队便宜地录音乐。

entries.en: How about a big billboard at the entrance to the town that reads, ‘TEEN WARNING – there’s nothing to do here!’
entries.zh: 在镇入口放一块大广告牌怎么样，上面写着：‘青少年警告——这里没事可做！’

entries.en: This probably sounds like a boring idea, but can’t we use some of the money to buy more litter bins?
entries.zh: 这听起来可能是个无聊的主意，但我们能不能用一部分钱多买一些垃圾桶？

entries.en: I feel ashamed of our town when I see all the litter on the ground.
entries.zh: 看到地上到处都是垃圾，我为我们的镇感到羞愧。

entries.en: We need to tidy up our town quickly!
entries.zh: 我们需要赶快把我们的镇收拾干净！
